otherFindings.summary: H6: some Rails time-zone names now map to different tz zones (for example, Astana), which shifts reminder times for affected users.
M3: the Rails built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1, and moving to Sidekiq 7 would affect redis.sadd and Redis::BaseError handling.
M4: Trix 2 CSS now comes from the action_text-trix gem, which mismatches the vendored Trix 1.3.5 JavaScript, and the importmap points at a UMD actiontext.js build.
M6: adopting the 7.1 HTML5 sanitizer default changes which tags rich text keeps.
M6: adopting the 7.1 cache and message format version defaults produces data that old Rails can't read, which matters on rollback.
